Politics · India

Rahul Gandhi Accuses PM Modi of Being 'Most Anti-Youth'

Opposition leader Rahul Gandhi has accused Prime Minister Narendra Modi of being the 'most anti-youth Prime Minister' India has seen. Gandhi's remarks followed a crackdown on young protesters marching towards Parliament. Gandhi stated that students are not criminals and criticized the government's actions. Some reports also mention a protest movement referred to as 'cockroach' protests, which has been a visible expression of public anger.
